raw:
@q query
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "fly to"
    role subject "Ms Cebotari"
    role destination ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?d
  measure end
  where match
    relation "employ"
    role subject "Atelier Wilson"
    role object "Achieng"
    role time ?d
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "reside in"
    role subject "Sigrid"
    role location "Kraków"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@s1 stated
  relation "lecture in"
  role subject "Agnieszka Nowak"
  role object "piano"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty supposed

@q4 query
  where match
    relation "lecture in"
    role subject "Agnieszka Nowak"
    role object "piano"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@s2 stated
  relation "stock"
  role subject "Constantinescu & Partners"
  role object "printer ink"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty supposed

@q5 query
  where match
    relation "stock"
    role subject "Constantinescu & Partners"
    role object "printer ink"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q6 query
  where match
    relation "look after"
    role subject "Toma"
    role object "the analytics pipeline"
    polarity affirmed
  end
